description: Look up compliance controls with evaluation criteria. Supports multiple frameworks: aiuc-1 (default), soc2-technical, gdpr-technical. Filter by domain, control IDs, or OWASP LLM tags.

domain.description: Filter by domain (e.g. 'security', 'safety', 'all'). Accepted values depend on the framework.

framework.description: Framework to query (default: aiuc-1). Use 'soc2-technical', 'gdpr-technical', etc.

owasp_filter.description: Filter by OWASP LLM tags (e.g. LLM01)

name: get_compliance_controls
